shortDesc: Academic resource sharing portal for Semester 5 Computer Science at IIT Kharagpur.
fullDesc:
A centralized academic resources portal created to aggregate and structure Semester 5 Computer Science coursework materials at IIT Kharagpur. It hosts course slides, syllabus directories, reference books, past exam papers, and laboratory assignment templates.

Core Idea:
Students often struggle to find study resources across scattered drives and channels. This portal aggregates documents by course codes and topics, making it extremely easy to navigate, view, and download study guides and exam resources dynamically.
highlights: Structures documents and syllabus topics by course code
Centralized portal to download past midterm and endterm exam papers
Hosted collection of laboratory codes, guidelines, and reference books
